target.title: Lossless Compression of JPEG Coded Photo Collections

feature_prediction.known: The 2014 precursor describes a matched-SIFT-distance prediction graph and a spanning prediction structure.
feature_prediction.missing: The complete 2016 objective, pruning, constraints, deterministic tie breaking, and changed method are unavailable.

global_compensation.known: Earlier papers describe homography, photometric transformation, SfM projection, and fallback selection.
global_compensation.missing: Exact 2016 estimation, interpolation, precision, edge handling, signaling, and rate selection are unavailable.

local_compensation.known: Earlier work combines a global transform with block motion compensation.
local_compensation.missing: Partitioning, search, costs, precision, interpolation, borders, predictors, tie breaking, and syntax are unavailable.

frequency_prediction.known: Earlier work transforms and quantizes the compensated predictor and stores exact target-coefficient residuals.
frequency_prediction.missing: The 2016 adaptive modes, contexts, coefficient order, selection, precision, and syntax are unavailable.

entropy_coding.known: The 2015 SfM extension names CABAC; the 2016 abstract names advanced context-adaptive entropy coding.
entropy_coding.missing: Contexts, initialization, updates, binarization, termination, alignment, and authoritative code are unavailable.

jpeg_binary_reconstruction.known: The product boundary can require and test restoration of every original JPEG byte and SHA-256.
jpeg_binary_reconstruction.substitution: PocketWorld coefficient framing can enforce exact reconstruction but is not the unpublished Microsoft bitstream.

evidence_ledger.claim: The 2016 work jointly exploits feature, spatial, and frequency redundancy and reports average savings above 31 percent relative to JPEG collections.
evidence_ledger.limitation: Abstract-level description; no complete algorithm or code on the audited page.

evidence_ledger.claim: The 2014 precursor uses SIFT-derived prediction structure, hybrid geometric/photometric/local compensation, and exact quantized-DCT residuals.
evidence_ledger.source: Author-uploaded 2014 paper, Lossless Compression of JPEG Coded Photo Albums
evidence_ledger.limitation: Precursor, not the 2016 TIP method; some implementation details are delegated or omitted.

evidence_ledger.claim: The 2015 extension uses incremental SfM, Delaunay/depth-based warping, homography fallback, block mode selection, and CABAC residual coding.
evidence_ledger.source: Author-uploaded 2015 paper, Incremental SfM Based Lossless Compression of JPEG Coded Photo Album
evidence_ledger.limitation: Precursor/extension; exact codec implementation and full bitstream are not supplied.

evidence_ledger.claim: OpenZL supports custom prediction graphs/codecs for multidimensional data, so an ACE-only experiment does not exhaust OpenZL's design space.
evidence_ledger.limitation: Capability evidence only; it does not supply the Microsoft photo predictor.

evidence_ledger.claim: The audited repository did not reveal a public author-owned reference implementation of the 2016 codec.
evidence_ledger.source: Exact-title and author/project searches across the Microsoft page, GitHub, and general web search
evidence_ledger.limitation: Absence cannot be proven globally; a private or differently named implementation may exist.

commercial_risk_signals.signal: The publication page's copyright/readability terms are not a software implementation license.
CABAC/HEVC-like elements require a separate patent and licensing analysis before commercial deployment.
WO2015006894A1, Feature-based image set compression, is a potentially related patent-family signal requiring claim-level counsel review.

allowed_next_step.claim_limit: May benchmark a separately specified exact semantic-photo codec; may not call it a faithful 2016 reproduction or use 31 percent as a promised result.
